controls.label: Embed link
controls.description: Paste the app's embed link. Google Maps: In Google Maps choose Share > Embed a map and copy the link inside src="…". Calendly: Your booking page link, for example https://calendly.com/your-shop/visit. Typeform: The form's share link, for example https://yourshop.typeform.com/to/abc123. Google Forms: In Google Forms choose Send > Embed and copy the link inside src="…". Spotify: In Spotify choose Share > Embed and copy the link inside src="…". SoundCloud: In SoundCloud choose Share > Embed and copy the link inside src="…". Airtable: In Airtable choose Share > Embed this view and copy the link inside src="…".
